ios.desc:
Anything Piano is the next generation of piano learning, built by music teachers and top AI researchers who've helped over 700,000 musicians play the songs they love. Paste any song your heart desires and our AI turns it into a piano roll tutorial you can play.

Even if you've never touched a piano and have no idea where to start, just follow the falling notes and you'll be playing your favorite songs in no time.

ANY SONG, NOT A FIXED CATALOG
We train our own AI models to create a piano version of any song you give us. Other apps force you to pick from their set catalog.

NO PIANO EXPERIENCE NEEDED
Forget the rules of sheet music. Every note lands right on the key in front of you, so you can see what to play and when. The song even waits for you to hit each note before it moves on.

WORKS WITH ANY PIANO
Connect a MIDI keyboard or sit down at an acoustic piano. Anything Piano listens either way and follows as you play.

SPEED CONTROL
Slow it down to learn the hard parts. Speed it back up as you get more comfortable with the song.

ONE HAND AT A TIME
Notes split into left and right hand, so you can master each separately before you put them together.

FINGER LABELS
We'll label which finger you should play each note with, making the learning process much smoother!

HOW IT WORKS
 1. Paste a link or upload a song.
 2. We build your own piano tutorial in about a minute.
 3. Play along and learn at your own pace.

Privacy Policy: https://playanything.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://playanything.com/terms
